item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E006","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The UN Special Envoy thanked Bangladesh for hosting more than one million Rohingya refugees for over five years, recorded Bangladesh’s position that the situation was unsustainable, and stated that return must be safe, voluntary, dignified, and address citizenship, movement, land, education, and livelihoods.","notes":["The supplied excerpt supports these claims but does not explicitly identify the remarks as occurring in March 2023."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E008","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The World Bank reports Bangladesh’s development gains, including reduced extreme poverty to 5.0% in 2022, gender parity in secondary enrollment, universal electricity access, increased female labor participation, climate-resilience investments, and shelter and support for more than one million Rohingya refugees; it also identifies inflation, energy shortages, balance-of-payments deficits, revenue shortfalls, and climate vulnerability as ongoing pressures.","notes":["The supplied excerpt does not establish that the results brief was published in November 2023 or that these pressures were specifically 2023-era."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E011","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0023-E012","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
